🎓 ICAP-APPROVED OVERSEAS TRAINING ORGANIZATION — ANK GLOBAL CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS, DUBAI 🇦🇪

We are proud to announce that ANK Global Chartered Accountants – Dubai has been officially approved by The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan (ICAP) as an Overseas Training Organization Inside Practice.

This important recognition enables ANK Global Chartered Accountants to provide structured practical training to ICAP students in the UAE, offering aspiring Chartered Accountants the opportunity to gain valuable professional experience in an international business environment.

This milestone reflects our continued commitment to professional excellence, quality training, knowledge development, and investing in the next generation of Chartered Accountants.

A special appreciation goes to Naffar Hussain ACA,APFA , CEO of ANK Global Group, for his dedicated efforts, leadership, and continuous follow-up throughout the approval process. His commitment and vision played an instrumental role in achieving this important recognition for the organization.

We also extend our sincere thanks and appreciation to the ICAP UAE Committee for their support and for formally presenting the certification to ANK Global Chartered Accountants. It was a privilege to receive this recognition in the presence of respected members of the professional community.

Our sincere gratitude goes to ICAP for the trust and recognition, and to the entire ANK Global team for their professionalism, dedication, and contribution toward this achievement.

We now look forward to welcoming ICAP trainees and providing them with meaningful practical exposure across Audit & Assurance, Accounting, Taxation, Advisory, Business Setup, ERP, Odoo, Compliance, and other professional services.

Developing talent today. Building the finance leaders of tomorrow.

Glad to have participated in the DAAT Technical Event on “Implementing UAE E-Invoicing: Practical Challenges and Risk Mitigation,” held in Dubai on 5 October 2026.

The session provided valuable insights into the UAE’s evolving e-invoicing landscape, including the government’s perspective on the rollout, implementation timelines, practical challenges businesses may encounter, and the importance of effective risk mitigation.

It was particularly useful to hear perspectives from government representatives, tax and compliance professionals, technology specialists, and finance leaders on how organizations can prepare for the transition from planning to implementation.

As UAE e-invoicing moves closer to becoming an operational reality, early preparation, cross-functional coordination, technology readiness, and a clear understanding of compliance requirements will be critical for a smooth transition.

Thank you to DAAT (Dubai Accountants, Auditors and Taxation Group), the speakers, panelists, and fellow participants for an informative and engaging evening.

Looking forward to applying these insights and continuing to learn as the UAE e-invoicing framework develops.

🌐 Connecting Technology, Finance & Growth at Seamless Dubai

It was a pleasure connecting with Mohamed Gouda , Nour Alamiri , and R Karan Kumar at Seamless Dubai, exchanging ideas around technology, digital transformation, and business growth.

A particularly relevant discussion with Mohamed Gouda from mazeed focused on accounting software and e-invoicing solutions—areas that strongly complement ANK Global’s work in accounting, ERP implementation, tax compliance, and digital transformation.

It was also valuable exchanging perspectives with Nour Alamiri and R Karan Kumar on digital marketing, e-commerce, AI-driven growth, business development, and building stronger market visibility.

These conversations highlight the potential for complementary expertise to come together and create meaningful partnerships, integrated solutions, and cross-border business opportunities across the UAE, GCC, and international markets.

🌍 Connecting Markets, People & Opportunities in UAE, Europe & Asia

It was a pleasure to attend the Cross-Cultural Networking Night in Dubai, organized by EurAsia Gulf - GCC Chapter , bringing together business leaders and professionals from diverse international markets.

The evening featured insightful contributions from Alibek Almabekov , Chairman of the Kazakhstan Business Council; Nawar Abdul Wahed  CEO of EurAsia Gulf; Milenko Bujandric , Chairman of the Serbian Business Council.

The discussions provided valuable perspectives on market opportunities, investment, regulatory developments, and cross-border collaboration—areas that are increasingly important as businesses look to expand into new markets.

For us at ANK Global Chartered Accountants and Fortuna Pro Group, such platforms are valuable for building relationships and exploring opportunities connecting the UAE & GCC with Europe, Central Asia and other international markets, particularly across business advisory, investment facilitation, accounting, tax, audit, ERP implementation and international business expansion.

Thank you to Nawar Abdul Wahed  and the EurAsia Gulf team for creating a valuable platform for meaningful international connections.

Connecting businesses. Bridging markets. Creating opportunities. 🌐🤝
